Denmark reported 1200 MW of capacity and 30 GWh of output. Germany reported 3400 MW of capacity and 95 GWh of output. Norway reported 900 MW of capacity and 28 GWh of output. Ireland reported 2100 MW of capacity and 60 GWh of output. Wind turbine counts were 14 turbines for Denmark, 31 turbines for Germany, 8 turbines for Norway, and 19 turbines for Ireland.
